newsitem.title: UK: Bradford wool slow, sterling a concern.
newsitem.headline: Bradford wool slow, sterling a concern.

text.p: There was very little fresh business and new orders were slow on the Bradford wool market due to the summer holiday period.
Traders said that companies were suffering from sterling's strength reducing the competitivity of their product abroad and, on the home market, it made imports more competitive.
The sources said wool and wool products are in a highly competitive global situation and traders have to avoid loss or loss of markets by taking covering action through the currency markets.
